note: All maths in js/progress-model.js (calibrated from the learner's own answers). Solid = replayed reality; dotted = expected-value simulation of the site's own scheduler. 'Done' = holding ≥90% of the basket recallable on any given day.

skills.note: Conservative by design: screen-knowledge is discounted for the ear (Goh 2000; Field 2008), isolated-word recognition is discounted for connected speech, coverage→comprehension is non-linear (van Zeeland & Schmitt 2013; Nation 2006), production is floored at the bottom of the receptive→productive range (Laufer 1998; Webb 2008) and capped by logged output time (DeKeyser). These numbers should UNDERSTATE.
